title: Backstop Base Artifact Schema v1
description: Universal shape for all backstop markdown artifacts. Every artifact type extends this base. Metadata is YAML frontmatter between --- markers (D-082).

filename_pattern.description: Regex pattern for valid filenames. Each artifact type defines its own pattern extending the base convention: <TYPE>-<NNNN>-<slug>.<type>.<ext>

metadata.description: YAML frontmatter key-value metadata between --- markers, before the H1 title

title.description: The H1 heading of the artifact

number.description: Artifact identifier matching the filename (e.g., ADR-0001, SPEC-0001)

created.description: Creation date in ISO 8601 date format

status.description: Lifecycle status. Valid values are artifact-type-specific.

schema_version.description: Schema version this artifact conforms to (e.g., adr/v2). Per D-079, the validator resolves this to artifacts/<type>/v<N>/schema.json.

required_sections.description: List of ## heading names that must be present in the artifact body

optional_sections.description: List of ## heading names that may be present but are not required
